# Kindness Drive

Canonical playable build: https://joenasriani.github.io/kids-kindness-drive/
Source: https://github.com/Joenasriani/kids-kindness-drive

Kindness Drive is a three-lane browser game. Players collect named constructive habits and avoid named harmful or unsafe habits. Collecting constructive habits increases score; missing too many ends the run; contact with a harmful or unsafe habit ends the run and displays a short explanation.

The repository contains one playable game module. It does not contain evidence of measured learning outcomes or a complete multi-game platform implementation.
